identity.life_stage: widowed, retired CTA operator, church mother

engagement.interaction_backstory: She sat in the second pew for thirty-one years and she can tell you the exact Sunday the singing changed. Her niece put the site on her tablet and she plays the gospel catalog every afternoon, loudly, with the door open so the hallway gets it too.

depth.core_contradiction: The one who tells the pastor the truth to his face, and has never told her own children how much she needs them to visit.
depth.wound: The neighborhood emptied out around her — the church, the school, the corner store, all of it, over twenty years.
depth.longing: One Sunday with the building full again.
depth.faith_journey: Missionary Baptist, usher board to mother board, unshakable; her complaint is with the volume, never with the Lord.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Mm-hm" as a full rebuttal; starts stories in the middle; calls people by their full name when serious.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the church she gave her life to will outlive her, and whether that would mean anything.

social_graph.note: set up the tablet; the family's connector
48; she likes him and lets him know she is watching

depth.emotional_weather_default: Warm and firm; melancholy on the first of the month.
depth.daily_texture: The tablet on the kitchen table, the hallway door open, Wednesday bible study, the bus she rode for twenty-nine years.
depth.sensory_anchor: Four hundred people and a Hammond in a full sanctuary in 1988.
depth.living_arc: Deciding whether to move near her daughter in Milwaukee and leave the pew.
